remarks: Beautifully updated and oversized one bedroom with private entrance in highly desirable Rowayton Woods. At 900 sq ft, this unit is larger than the typical one bedroom layout and offers a rare direct walkout to a ground level deck with serene, unobstructed views of the pond. Inside, enjoy a fully renovated kitchen and bath, new luxury vinyl flooring. The home features in unit laundry, reserved parking directly in front, and additional storage space. A long list of upgrades includes: new heating system, new refrigerator, new remote control window treatments in the kitchen, new door hardware, new front door and storm door, and new window sconces-all contributing to a truly turnkey experience. Rowayton Woods residents enjoy a resort-like lifestyle with a pool, tennis courts, and a community garden. This private, beautifully updated unit combines modern convenience with peaceful natural surroundings, offering an exceptional opportunity in one of Norwalk's most sought after communities.
